body:
# 🪙 Slime Rancher Mod

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4649a0f383f4fa78be37fa3874d488f0af520305.png)

Bring the colorful economy and advanced breeding of the Far, Far Range into your Minecraft world! **Slime Rancher Mod** is a fully functional management, economy, and exploration mod for 1.20.1 that allows you to capture, ranch, crossbreed, and profit from unique custom slimes. 

Build your ranch, experiment with slime DNA, and amass a fortune of Newbucks!

---

## 🚀 Key Gameplay Mechanics

* 🧪 **The Largo DNA System:** Every single slime in this mod can be combined! By feeding a slime a different type of Plort, it will mutate and combine traits. Experiment with combinations to maximize your ranch's efficiency!
* 💎 **The Plort Economy:** Feed your ranch slimes to harvest their **Plorts**. Take these plorts to market, sell them, and earn **Newbucks** to amass your fortune.
* 🎈 **Gordo Slimes & Exploration:** Discover massive, immovable Gordo Slimes hidden across your world. Feed them massive amounts of food until they explode to obtain a rare **Slime Key** to unlock secrets.
* 🧬 **Custom Spawning System:** Slimes don't just spawn randomly like regular mobs. To start your ranch, you must explore the map, locate and capture a **Slime Spawner**, and place it safely inside your base.

---

## 🧼 Slime Varieties & Genetics

Discover the core slime species used to create your ultimate hybrids:

* ✨ **Pure Slime:** The absolute baseline of your ranch. They are the cheapest and most common slimes, but they possess a unique trait: feeding a Pure Slime any type of Plort will instantly transform it into the slime type that produced that plort!
* 🌸 **Pink Slime:** The classic, cheerful slime. Eager to eat anything and perfect for early-game ranching.
* 🌿 **Grass Slime:** A nature-attuned variant that thrives in lush environments.
* 💧 **Blue Slime:** A cool, aquatic-themed slime with specific resource needs.
* 🔮 **Purple Slime:** A mysterious and rare variant that yields highly valuable plorts.

---

## ⚙️ Compatibility & Requirements
* **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1
* **Supported Loaders:** Forge
